verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only generic marketing claims about AI/LLM capability (fine-tuning, local AI agents) and no documentation of FP8/FP4 precision support or named serving stacks like TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, ROCm, or llama.cpp for this specific part. Community threads even suggest the opposite trend—SM120 (this card's architecture) 'lack[s] support in main libraries' since focus is on B300/SM100—further indicating no confirmed documented inference stack story. Missing for 10: explicit FP8/FP4 support documentation, named serving-stack compatibility (TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, ROCm, llama.cpp) benchmarks or guides for this SKU.
